mapper.select: SELECT holiday_year, content_json, verified_date FROM calendar_holiday_cache WHERE holiday_year = #{year}
SELECT holiday_year FROM calendar_holiday_cache ORDER BY holiday_year
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_holiday_cache (holiday_year, content_json, verified_date) VALUES (#{holidayYear}, #{contentJson}, #{verifiedDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_json = #{contentJson}, verified_date = #{verifiedDate}
